SUBSCRIBE! http://bit.ly/subpurevolume

The guys from Pierce The Veil answer fan questions in this exclusive interview with PureVolume! Can they see themselves teaming up with Kellin Quinn for another collabo? How did their parents react when they found out they wanted to be in a band? Or got their first tattoo? Watch the video to find out the answers to these questions and more!

You can purchase Pierce the Veil's latest album 'Collide With The Sky' on iTunes. Learn more at http://piercetheveil.net
